column4: Formats a rejection's evidence as tenant_read fields through Assessment::record_fields; the frame was already withheld by judge::admit.
Writes the audit record of a frame judge::admit already withheld and only logs a failure; the content stays withheld whatever it does.
RejectionAudit Debug prints whether a log is set and the saturation count; formatting.
RejectionAudit::new stores the log and a permit semaphore; constructor, the withhold decision is the judge's.
OutboundFrame::response is a read-only getter of the answer for the status line; the judge already decided its content.
OutboundFrame::is_answer reports the payload kind so recorded picks refusal over withhold; recorded makes the fail-closed decision.
OutboundFrame::answer_document clones the answer as JSON for a delivery record hash; formatting, the verdict is judge::delivered's.
Returns emit_http_checked's response and drops its flag; the fail-closed decision is emit_pending's.
OutboundFrame::verdict is a getter of the assessment's verdict for reporting; judge::assess decides it and judge::withholds acts on it.
OutboundFrame::assessment is a getter of the stored judgement; judge::assess made it.
OutboundFrame::carry_holds attaches the sealed holds an answer's result carries (MIK-8176); slot lifetime bookkeeping, no allow or deny.
OutboundFrame::hand_off_holds hands off carried holds when the stdio writer takes the frame; bookkeeping after the judge ran.
OutboundFrame::answer_id reads the answer's request id for a replacement refusal; getter, the replacement is decided by recorded or the judge.
Returns what the current read scope noted via tenant_reads::noted; getter, the judge decides what the reads mean.
OutboundReply IntoResponse unwraps the inner response; the judging happened in the constructor that built it.
Returns judged_reply_checked's reply and drops its flag; the fail-closed decision is emit_pending's.
StreamJudge Debug prints only whether judging is on and a key is bound; formatting.
StreamJudge::record forwards to recorded with the stream's log; recorded makes the fail-closed decision.
StreamJudge::emit forwards to emit_http with the stream's log; emit_pending makes the fail-closed decision.
StreamJudge::judges forwards to outbound::judges on its guard; judge::judging decides.
StreamJudge::judge_document wraps a document as a Request payload and forwards to admit; admit_hiding and judge::admit decide.
StreamJudge::admit forwards to admit_hiding with no hidden attribution; admit_hiding decides.
StreamJudge::judge wraps a notification and forwards to admit; admit_hiding and judge::admit decide.
Formats sse_data's output as an event: message SSE frame; sse_data decides what is written.
SessionJudge Debug prints nothing but the type name; formatting.
SessionJudge::raw forwards to raw_attribution with its guard; judge::attribute takes the attribution.
